---
"@savvy-web/silk-effects": patch
---

## Bug Fixes

* Dependency-table cells generated by `serializeDependencyTable` (and the `DepsRegen` changeset flow) no longer backslash-escape characters that don't need it in a table cell — `~0.2.1`, `some_pkg`, and `_private` now render literally instead of as `\~0.2.1`, `some\_pkg`, `\_private`. A literal `|` inside a cell is still escaped, since that character is structurally significant in a Markdown table row.
* Existing changesets written with the old escaped spelling still parse and lint identically; re-serializing one normalizes it to the new literal spelling. No exported API changed — this only affects the bytes written into generated dependency tables. Builds on `@effected/markdown` 0.13.0's literal text emission (spencerbeggs/effected#489).
